question: How should electronics and vape-adjacent brands prepare a custom paper packaging RFQ?
buyerContext: Electronics and vape-adjacent packaging buyers often need structure review, insert planning, protection notes and premium retail presentation before price comparison.
domesticBorrow: Domestic factory sites usually make structure, finish and box-type choices easy to scan, which helps buyers move quickly toward a quotation brief.
overseasBorrow: Overseas sites tend to explain application fit and procurement steps more clearly, which helps reduce unclear briefs and repeated sampling loops.

company: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
checklist: Product dimensions, product weight and expected order quantity range.
Packaging structure, opening style, insert or protection requirement.
Material direction, surface finish, print coverage and artwork status.
Target market, retail or ecommerce channel and any claim-sensitive use case.
Sample expectation, RFQ priority and destination country for logistics discussion.
domesticCompetitorTakeaway: Domestic factory sites usually make structure, finish and box-type choices easy to scan, which helps buyers move quickly toward a quotation brief.
overseasCompetitorTakeaway: Overseas sites tend to explain application fit and procurement steps more clearly, which helps reduce unclear briefs and repeated sampling loops.
avoidance: Do not use fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, lowest-price, capacity, customer-case or regulatory claims unless verified for the exact project.
Do not treat competitor names as partners, customers, data providers or endorsements.
Do not make food-contact, cosmetic regulatory or sustainability guarantees without supporting documents.
